tools.name: check_trip
tools.description: Check whether devices from one country will work in another, for questions like "do I need an adapter for Japan?" or "will my UK charger work in the US?". Use when both a home country and a destination are known; for one country alone use country_plugs. Takes an English country name or ISO code for

tools.name: country_plugs
tools.description: Look up the outlet and plug types, mains voltage and frequency of one country, for questions like "what sockets does Italy use?". Use when no home country is given; to compare two countries use check_trip. Takes an English country name or ISO code. Returns the types, voltage and frequency, regional

tools.name: find_countries_by_outlet
tools.description: Search for every country whose wall outlets are of one plug type, for questions like "which countries use Type G?" or "where else does my Type C plug work?". Use when the question starts from a plug type rather than a place; for one known country use country_plugs. Takes an IEC letter from A to O. R

tools.name: plug_type
tools.description: Describe one plug type itself: its standard, pin layout, whether it is earthed and which plugs its socket accepts, for questions like "what is a Type F plug?" or "does a Type C plug fit a Type F socket?". Not about any country: to list where a type is used call find_countries_by_outlet. Takes an IEC
